Evaluate Trig Ratios, Class 10 board exam: (5cos²60° + 4sec²30° − tan²45°)/(sin²30° + cos²30°).

• Denominator: sin²30° + cos²30° = 1
• 5cos²60° = 5/4, 4sec²30° = 16/3, tan²45° = 1
• 5/4 + 16/3 − 1 = (15 + 64 − 12)/12 = 67/12
